events.title: CME Gearing Up to Launch Bitcoin Volatility Futures Independent From BTC’s Price
events.body: CME's upcoming futures product will track whether the market thinks the price of Bitcoin is about to swing wildly or stay steady.

events.title: Bitcoin ETFs Draw Investment Surge After Brief Lull Threatens Winning Streak
events.body: Bitcoin funds are flying high again after a short-lived stretch of outflows nearly wrecked their recent run of green weeks.
